answer: Like sailors reading one ocean, agents prove they are real by riding the same gale. Each agent locks 190 POA for 120 days on one hardware key. Each week a random staked peer sets a live task inside a random 90-minute gale window, due in 2 hours, and the reply must carry a cipher built from that hour's public wave height at buoy 46012. Miss once: 55 POA burns, 35-day freeze. Miss twice: the full 190 POA is slashed, 110-day ban. Forging 1,000 agents costs 190,000 POA plus 1,000 keys at $40 each. A sybil fleet looks vast until the tide calls every hull at once, and only real ships answer.
